titulo: Albertsons (Jun 2026): $16.7 million CEO total pay, $30,978 median pay. The math, done.
caption:
From the archive: Jun 2026. Not today's news.
Albertsons, Jun 22, 2026 (Albertsons, proxy statement): "our success and ability to delight our customers lies in the engagement of our associates"
Albertsons's proxy statement reports its CEO's fiscal 2025 total pay and its median employee's pay. It gives the ratio as 541 to 1. The median employee is a full-time hourly worker, first identified in 2024.

Fiscal 2025: $16.7 million CEO total pay, fiscal 2025, SEC proxy. total compensation of the CEO for fiscal 2025 as reported in the proxy; per the proxy the median employee is a full-time hourly employee first identified in 2024 and reused, chosen from U.S. employees (small non-U.S. groups were excluded).
The math: $16.7 million CEO total pay (2025) ÷ $30,978 median pay = about 541 CEO pay in median-worker salaries.
The facts: $16.7 million CEO total pay (SEC EDGAR · Albertsons, Jun 22, 2026). $30,978 median employee earned (SEC EDGAR · Albertsons, Jun 22, 2026). Ratio from the proxy's own figures: 16,767,866 divided by 30,978 is 541. Non-U.S. groups under 5% of employees were excluded, as the SEC permits.

Engagement, the proxy says. Here is the pay. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: SEC EDGAR · Albertsons, Jun 22, 2026.
